title: Kingfisher on Lily Pond
description: A vibrant kingfisher with blue head, orange chest and multicolored wings perches on a stem among large green lily pads and white water lilies. Several orange goldfish swim in the dark, swirling purple and teal water that features glowing circular ripple patterns in the background.
prompt: A colorful kingfisher with bright blue head and orange chest perched on a stem beside white water lilies and giant green lily pads, several orange goldfish swimming around in dark mystical water with glowing purple and teal swirling ripple patterns, atmospheric fantasy nature scene, detailed painting style
